name: Brumidi Lodge (Sons of Italy)
factsSource: Checked October 3, 2026. Sources: sonsofitalyli.com, thedancecalendar.com, facebook.com, google.com.
parkingNotes: Large parking lot ("Huge Parking Lot" in the lodge's own ad).
accessibilityNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking lot.
reviewNotes: On Route 231. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Brumidilodge. "Largest dance floor on Long Island" is the lodge's own claim and is not recorded as fact.
